title: Troubleshooting Gurgling Drains and Vent Blockages
description: When a fixture gurgles or drains slowly despite a clean P-trap, the issue often stems from a compromised plumbing vent. Plumbing vents equalize pressure within the drainage system, allowing water to flow smoothly without pulling water out of traps. A clogged vent stack—caused by debris, bird nests, or ice—creates negative pressure during discharge. This vacuum pulls the protective water seal out of nearby traps, allowing sewer gases to enter the building. Inspecting the roof vent stack and clearing obstructions restores proper atmospheric pressure and stops trap siphonage.

Troubleshooting Gurgling Drains and Vent Blockages

When a fixture gurgles or drains slowly despite a clean P-trap, the issue often stems from a compromised plumbing vent. Plumbing vents equalize pressure within the drainage system, allowing water to flow smoothly without pulling water out of traps. A clogged vent stack—caused by debris, bird nests, or ice—creates negative pressure during discharge. This vacuum pulls the protective water seal out of nearby traps, allowing sewer gases to enter the building. Inspecting the roof vent stack and clearing obstructions restores proper atmospheric pressure and stops trap siphonage.
